name: Willow Aconite
original_name: ウィロウ・アコニット
source:
[i]"Yulewood, huh? There really wouldn't be a stronger shield than that."[/i]

[i]Affectionate Believer[/i]

Eugene's subordinate at his side job as a trader. An earnest and gentle sort who's never once engaged in haggling or scheming. But that kindness often sees him duped by those with ill intentions. He's known Eugene since they were both young, and they maintain a practical relationship with very little meddling in each other's lives.

[From [url=https://products.voltage.co.jp/kaleido/english/characters/?page=willow]Voltage Inc.[/url]]
